source_snapshot.procedure:
【Before Test】
    1. Check that the SUT configuration (e.g., hardware, firmware, drivers, etc.) matches the specifications/recipe definition.
    2. Clear logs (e.g., dmesg, syslog, SEL, etc.).

    【During Test】
    Enter BMC Web UI -> Select "Hardware status" > Click tab "Inventory and LEDs" then check the Storage controller information and detail information

    【After Test】
    1. Collect test results and photos, and save them to specific folders.
    2. Check if there are unexpected logs (e.g., dmesg, syslog, SEL, etc.) generate after test.
source_snapshot.criteria:
1. Data should be readable and correct.
2. Check the storage controller status is fit actual status
3. Check controller FW ver is correct

deepseek_columns.ai_logs_output: return FULL pretty-printed JSON from /redfish/v1/Systems/system/Storage (storage controller (RAID/HBA) details) so user can read/diff against SPEC for "Storage controller (RAID/HBA) details". No RISK (read-only).

historical_reviews.deepseek: YES assumes flat `.StorageControllers`, uses a questionable jq subexpression and reports only name/firmware through curl -k; RAID/HBA type, topology, health, relations and action boundaries are absent.
historical_reviews.gpt_v2: REQUIRES PACKAGE / USER CONFIRMATION / CHANGED requires complete linked controller enumeration, topology/type/status/health/firmware/drive-volume relations and no RAID mutation.
historical_reviews.round_02: Entry 972/2291 accepts the two-field controller list as direct evidence.
historical_reviews.related_source_cases: The preceding drive case validates per-drive slots; it cannot establish controller type, PCIe identity, firmware or RAID/HBA relationships.
historical_reviews.v3_1: ED-33 preserves WebUI detail; ED-34 allows approved read-only tools; ED-35 prevents name/version-only reduction; ED-36 treats topology/reference as readiness; storage configuration changes remain out of scope.

original_test_intent: Verify each RAID/HBA storage controller's details, actual status and firmware version are readable and correct in BMC WebUI.
original_method: Traverse the full Storage model, bind every controller to its PCIe/enclosure/drive topology, collect protected read-only identity, controller type, health, status, firmware, features and relations, and compare with WebUI and the approved controller matrix without RAID or firmware changes.
manual_activity: The owner supplies the controller inventory/topology, RAID versus HBA role and accepted firmware/health semantics. The agent may read and normalize; final controller-status judgment remains engineer-owned.
safety_requirements: Do not create/delete/modify arrays or volumes, import foreign configuration, flash firmware, power-cycle or reset.
Do not assume `.StorageControllers` is complete or flat.
Use trusted transport and protected credentials.
Do not follow action links during inventory collection.
Stop on ambiguous controller identity, stale status or incomplete links without automatic retry.
agent_execution_scope: Resolve the actual ComputerSystem Storage resources and all controller links/pages.
Map every RAID/HBA to PCIe/location, drives and volumes.
Compare with WebUI and approved controller matrix.
Return evidence only with RAID/storage state unchanged.
engineer_actions: Approve controller identities, topology and roles.
Review discrepancies and issue formal verdict.

command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: Partial and schema-fragile: name/version cannot prove complete controller population, RAID/HBA role, PCIe mapping, health or associated drive/volume state.
command_applicability.command_recommendation: Traverse linked controller resources, normalize complete per-controller topology and lifecycle fields, and compare to the approved matrix without invoking actions.
command_applicability.original_parameters_and_time_preserved: Storage controller (RAID/HBA) details, WebUI method, three Criteria and original time values remain preserved.

modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Perform complete topology-bound, read-only RAID/HBA controller inventory/status/firmware reconciliation.
modernized_recommendation.supported_version: Record BMC, Redfish Storage schema and parser versions.
modernized_recommendation.official_reference: Vendor controller topology/health specification and Project firmware matrix.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Adds linked resource traversal, RAID/HBA role, relations, full health/status and explicit no-action controls while retaining WebUI comparison.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: Controller name and firmware alone cannot establish physical identity, role, health, supported features or storage relationships.
modernized_recommendation.required_inputs: Controller map, role/health semantics and accepted firmware reference.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: Stale controller state can conceal degradation; following configuration/action links could affect availability or data and is forbidden.

project_override_considerations: Alternate controller inventory tools require exact PCIe/controller identity and equivalent role/health/firmware/relation coverage, engineer approval and disclosure of uncovered WebUI/Redfish fields.
expected_evidence: Complete controller collection/link and topology map
Per-controller RAID/HBA role, location, health/status, firmware, feature and relation matrix

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: Master consistently targets controller detail/status/firmware; the DeepSeek two-field query is incomplete guidance, not a competing purpose.

blocked_analysis.analysis: The RAID/HBA inventory goal is clear; topology, role semantics and firmware expectations are Project readiness inputs.

comparison_to_prior_reviews.deepseek: Adds linked enumeration, exact topology/role, full health and relation evidence.
comparison_to_prior_reviews.gpt_v2: Independently agrees with hybrid classification and strict no-storage/no-firmware mutation.
comparison_to_prior_reviews.round_02: Rejects two-field direct-run evidence as full controller validation.
comparison_to_prior_reviews.related_source_cases: Keeps controller coverage distinct from individual drive coverage.

review_improvement: Prevents a correct-looking name/version pair from hiding a missing, misidentified or degraded controller and explicitly blocks RAID actions.
independent_technical_reasoning: RAID/HBA controllers may be linked through different Storage resources and can share names. SIT correctness needs exact PCIe/topology identity, controller role, live health and firmware plus drive/volume relationships; inventory traversal must never cross into array configuration, foreign import or firmware update.
